subject: Convene: POC kickoff — owners, acceptance criteria & calendar windows
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@uplift.co>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@uplift.co>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@uplift.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — propose two windows

Maya / Karthik —

Thanks for the time on Friday. We're ready to kick off the POC for the payments reconciliation flow and want to align a short kickoff with engineering, procurement, and security before we hand you the test data. High-level asks from our side:

- Introductions and owner mapping (AE / SE / CS / Uplift engineers)
- Walkthrough of success criteria and minimal test dataset
- Timeline and gating for procurement/security review

Two candidate windows from our side:
- Wed, Jun 9, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu, Jun 10, 14:00–15:15 PT

Can you confirm who from Redwood would lead the demo + acceptance criteria section? Also attaching the Uplift security questionnaire for visibility (uplift-security-questions-2026.xlsx).

Thanks —
Alex Jenkins
Head of Platform Partnerships | Uplift Health
alex.jenkins@uplift.co
Attachment: uplift-security-questions-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@uplift.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@uplift.co>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@uplift.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — propose two windows

Alex — thanks for the clear windows. We can do either with a couple of clarifications so the kickoff is actionable:

Owners (Redwood):
- AE / kickoff leadership: Maya Srinivasan (me)
- SE / demo + validation plan: Soojin Lee
- Technical success / onboarding + ticketing: Ben Carter
- Escalation/contract questions: Karthik Iyer

Requested from Uplift: engineering lead + procurement + security presence for the first 30 minutes. If security cannot attend live, please confirm the primary contact and we'll separate a follow-up deep-dive.

Suggested kickoff agenda (30–45 minutes):
1) Intros + roles (5–7m)
2) Demo walkthrough: scope & inputs (10–12m)
3) Success criteria & acceptance checklist (8–10m)
4) Timeline & next steps (5m)

I'll attach our standard POC runbook (redwood-poc-runbook-v1.pdf) — it includes the acceptance checklist we'll use during the POC. If you can confirm which window works and who will own the acceptance sign-off from Uplift, we'll lock the invite.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-poc-runbook-v1.pdf (pdf)
